summary: Valuation factory: SEC EDGAR XBRL import → typed statement store → two Monte Carlo DCF engines (classic scenario + driver-based) → adversarial review pipeline → published report + single-page HTML visualizer. Standing initiative: PLANNING/reusable-dcf-vision.md (self-improving: accepted review findings compound into rules/validators).
phase: Post IBM v4.1 (2026-07-17). Vision P1 is the active frontier: rulebook extraction (RULES.md has R1 + backlog), validators, red-team corpus, coverage validator. Queued: ORCL frontier run; IBM Q2/Q3 2026 watch-list grading (IBM reported Q2 on 2026-07-22; grading still open). Live open-work state: PLANNING/handoff/ (one file per person); consolidated open tickets: PLANNING/tickets.md §OPEN TICKETS.
flagship_analysis: IBM v4.1 — analysis/IBM/report/IBM-valuation-2026-07.md. Headline (driver engine, seed 7, conditional on f=0.50): P10 $83.84 / P50 $151.84 / P90 $258.03 vs price $212.40. Watch list grades at the July 22, 2026 Q2 report.
docs: CLAUDE.md (norms + normativity map, read first) · docs/DOC-STANDARD.md (doc rules; registry: python scripts/doc_check.py list) · docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (code-verified module map) · docs/HIDDEN-ASSUMPTIONS.md (trap registry) · PLANNING/reusable-dcf-vision.md (standing design, 7 amendments + basket amendment)
entry_points: scripts.analyze TICKER (import + market data → 9-tab xlsx) · scripts.import_financials · scripts.import_edgar · scripts.run_dcf (classic engine) · scripts.backtest (point-in-time vintages) · scripts.visualize_dcf (single-page HTML report) · analysis.IBM.dcf_drivers_run (v4 headline) · analysis.IBM.dcf_scenarios (v3, historical) · python -m pytest (full suite, no network)
engines: financial_analysis/dcf.py — classic: samples growth/margin/WACC/tg directly, presets in scenarios.py (IBM entries there are the v3 framework, deliberate). financial_analysis/driver_dcf.py — driver-based: deterministic vetted item formulas over correlated stochastic drivers, one draw per path, per-path WACC (kd derived from rf), joint tg<WACC-2% guard, percentiles only, ±1σ same-seed attribution. Per-ticker register: analysis/<TICKER>/driver_model.py (rationale strings are NORMATIVE over DRIVERS.md prose).
xbrl_path: SEC companyfacts JSON API — data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyfacts/CIK{padded_cik}.json. Primary parse path; raw EDGAR downloads are archival fallback (scripts.import_edgar). companyfacts strips dimensional facts: segment revenue is NOT extractable from it (Ticket 7).
store_note: data/processed/TICKER.json persists statement periods ONLY — prices/options/estimates live in the xlsx and dated snapshots under data/raw/TICKER/. filed_date on companyfacts-sourced periods is the filing the figure was drawn from (often a later 10-K's comparative column) — backtest vintages are conservative, not optimistic.
fcf_sign_note: capex is stored sign-flipped (negative) by the importer; schema.free_cash_flow uses OCF - abs(capex). Fixed 2026-06-12 (was overstating FCF by 2x capex).
current_focus: P1: validators.py + red-team corpus + coverage validator (vision P1; RULES.md backlog)
ORCL frontier run under the cheapened pipeline, then basket + gap decomposition (PLANNING/handoff/luc.md)
IBM watch-list grading (Q2 reported 2026-07-22; still open): grade the 5-item watch list + 2026 mechanical vintage, first bet-ledger entries (PLANNING/handoff/luc.md)
orchestration: Subagents do not commit — the orchestrator collects and commits. Parallel work in git worktrees off origin/main; never check out a branch in the shared main tree (see CLAUDE.md). Token ledger updated per run: PLANNING/token-ledger.md.
smoke_test_policy: Every ticket requires a live smoke test before closing. A ticket is not done until real output is printed and confirmed consumable by the next ticket.
notes: Agents should be concise when updating README.md and context.json.
